name: grokbot-zone
description: A searchable directory of public Grok bot listings.

scripts.prebuild: tsx scripts/build-data.ts && tsx scripts/build-classifier.ts && tsx scripts/build-trending.ts && tsx scripts/build-api.ts && tsx scripts/sync-readme.ts && tsx scripts/assert-counts.ts && tsx scripts/copy-wasm.ts
scripts.build: tsx scripts/build-worker.ts && astro build && tsx scripts/assert-no-emails.ts
scripts.riv:build: python3 scripts/gen-rive-src.py && rive rive/hero-grid --once && rive rive/bot-pulse --once && cp rive/hero-grid/build/hero-grid.riv rive/bot-pulse/build/bot-pulse.riv public/riv/
